finding: Useful primary personal advantage over base, pooled and donor is excluded under both interval methods, with all model-rival intervals including zero. Useful primary uniform advantage remains unresolved under both methods. Its writer interval favors personal adaptation at zero but does not establish the useful margin, and the crossed interval includes zero. Residual donor and pooled useful advantages remain unresolved under both methods, with all their intervals including zero. Useful residual uniform advantage is excluded under both methods and both intervals include zero. Raw sums exclude useful advantage against all model rivals under both methods, include zero in all model-rival intervals and are worse than uniform under both methods. No useful personal benefit or parity is established.
limits: Selected model prose reflects available suggestions and earlier choices rather than human-only production. Sparse histories, shared or changed units, one larger-model seed and transferred rank preclude independent human confirmation, backbone or corpus ranking, general personal-learning limits and private-goal inference. Other matrix cells remain unfinished; failed and unknown predecessors remain separate.
